text.en:
The Domingo Lacson High School in the City of Bacolod is converted into a national high
school, to be known as the Domingo Lacson National High School.

The Ministry of Education, Culture and Sports is directed to take such steps as are necessary for
the conversion and operation of the school and immediate implementation of this Act.

The amount of one hundred thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be funded out of
the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Blg. 131 and Batas Pambansa Blg. 230 for the Ministry of
Education, Culture and Sports intended for new national schools: Provided, That the local government unit
concerned shall continue to provide funding for its share of the cost of maintenance and operation of the
school. Thereafter, the amount needed for the operation and maintenance of the school shall be included in the
annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 7, 1983
